object.name: evi_randy
object.digest: Cubic interpolated version of the linear MSP <o>rand~</o>
object.description: Being cubic interpolated the spectrum of this random oscillator rolls off much more steeply than the output of <o>rand~</o>, which may or may not be useful. At LFO frequencies this is a really useful smooth control source. @see: 'evi_sources.genexpr' and 'evi_lfo.genexpr' for more like this.

inlets.name: frequency
inlets.digest: Frequency at which to sample new values internally, controlling the speed of the segments.

outlets.name: white
outlets.digest: The white noise source used to create rand output.
